name: aegisvault
description: AegisVault: gestor de contraseñas local-first para navegadores (en desarrollo; no auditado).

scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs index.html package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs index.html package.json tsconfig.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run verify:build
